---
title: "Roadmap"
---

This page lists planned and in-progress work for FeRx. Timelines are indicative
and may shift as priorities evolve. Feel free to reach out with any feature requests,
research project proposals, or feedback.

## Short term (Q2–Q3 '26)

- Improve testing infrastructure with larger coverage, with more real datasets and models.
- NONMEM and nlmixr2 model import. nlmixr2 models can be supported in a
  non-lossy way, since they can be read from the R object.
- Increase modularity of FeRx, so external users can more easily write
  extensions with minimal (if any) modifications to FeRx core code.

## Medium term (Q4 '26)

- Release of v1.0.0.
- Benchmark vignette and subsequent publication in a journal.
- Support for count data models (Poisson).
- Support for Item Response Theory models.
- Support for optimal design analyses. At least computation of the FIM, and
  basic optimal design searches. Potentially in a separate R package.

## Recently delivered

Previously on this roadmap, and available as of v0.4.0 (see the [changelog](changelog.qmd)):

- [TTE / survival modeling](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/tte.html), including joint PK–survival models.
- [Stiff ODE solvers](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/model-file/ode-models.html#solver-details).
- [FREM estimation](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/frem.html).
- Covariate search: [GAM screening](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/tools/gam-screening.html) and [SCM](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/tools/covsearch.html).
- Exact analytic sensitivities through the ODE solver.
- [Priors](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/priors.html) on model parameters.
- [Mixture models](https://ferx-nlme.org/ferx-core/estimation/mixture.html).

## Ongoing research projects

- Copula-estimation of between-subject variability with SAEM.
- Improved support for neural nets: deep compartmental models and neural ODEs.
